note: Photo-driven accuracy cases. Photos load from <photos dir>/<case id>/*.jpg|jpeg|png|webp (at most 4, sorted by name). The committed tests/fixtures/accuracy/photos/ folders hold labelled placeholder drawings; pass --photos <dir> with real photos for a meaningful live run.

cases.idea: Our two-storey house from this photo
cases.composition: The house only on a small lawn base. No street, fence, trees or neighbouring houses.
criticalChecks: Roof shape and pitch match the photo
Front door, porch and windows sit on the photographed facade in the same arrangement
Two storeys plus the dormered roof, not one storey or three

cases.idea: Our dog from this photo, sitting
cases.composition: The dog only, sitting on a small display base.
criticalChecks: Body, leg and head proportions match the photo
Coat colours and the white chest match the photo

cases.composition: The car only on a short road base. Keep the photographed body style.
criticalChecks: Wheelbase and wheel positions match the photo

cases.idea: This DC Metro station from my photos
cases.composition: One station interior: the coffered vault, both side platforms, the two tracks and one train on the left track. No street entrance or mezzanine.
features: Silver train on the left track
criticalChecks: The coffered vault spans both tracks
Two side platforms, not one island platform
The train is on the left track as photographed
